verdicts.reason: A breaks the lockup: the headline is small and floats at the top while the gold leaf wreath is separated from it, sits as an empty arc over the dark cloth and overlaps the fig. The text no longer reads as the focal point and the brand mark is lost. B keeps the wreath wrapped around a large 'Perfect Taste', so it stays the same design. It is slightly crowded by the fig at the bottom of the wreath and the wreath is a little off-centre, but those are minor polish items.
